_comment: GIWA Sepolia (chainId 91342) — Dunamu/Upbit OP-Stack L2 testnet. Backs the `giwa` environment at giwa.fypherfi.com. Unlike HOODI and mainnet, this deployment is FULLY SELF-CONTAINED: there is no BitGo custody and no Concrete vault on GIWA, so FYUSD is issued by our own on-chain FyusdTeller against MockERC20 test stables, and Earn yield comes from MockConcreteAdapter instead of the real Concrete integration. Populated by scripts/deploy-giwa-phase0.js, then scripts/deploy-phase1.js and scripts/deploy-yield-vaults.js (both chain-generic). See scripts/deploy-giwa.js for the full runbook.
